Run the scaler analysis (top scalers, scalers to mid-caps) from files

Source: R/run-scaler-analysis.R
run_scaler_analysis.Rd

New analysis, after run_scaleup_pipeline() (or run_trade_pipeline()): reads the indicators panel those write to config$input_dir, preferring trade_accounts_indicators_<country>.dta (it adds exporter status as a breakdown) over accounts_indicators_<country>.dta, runs compute_top_scalers() twice (without and with joint_growth) and compute_midcap_transitions(), and writes to config$output_dir:

  • sa_top_scalers_<country>.csv (both versions, column joint_growth);

  • sa_midcap_incidence_<country>.csv, sa_midcap_entry_<country>.csv, sa_midcap_by_year_<country>.csv, sa_midcap_coverage_<country>.csv, sa_midcap_hazard_<country>.csv.

Usage

run_scaler_analysis(config)

Arguments

config

A scaleup_config from config_scaleup().

Value

Invisibly, a list of the tables written.

Details

The money variables of the indicators panel are in EUR thousand (the build rescales them, see financials_unit in config_scaleup()), as the mid-cap thresholds need; compute_midcap_transitions() stops if they look like euros.
